hook: Democrats now control both House and Senate
reel_hook: Congress flipped. Here's what else happened.

slides.title: Democrats win both chambers
slides.image_prompt: US Capitol dome at dawn with neat stacks of blank paper ballots and a ballot box in the foreground, soft golden light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Democrats won the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterms.
WHY IT MATTERS
It would be their largest House majority since 2008.
FOR YOU
The new Congress starts next year; Mississippi's Senate race is still too close to call.
slides.body: Democrats won the House and Senate in Tuesday's midterms. It would be their largest House majority since 2008. The new Congress starts next year; Mississippi's Senate race is still too close to call.

slides.title: More tankers hit in Hormuz
slides.image_prompt: Large oil tanker crossing a narrow strait at dusk, distant smoke on the horizon, calm dark water
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran says more tankers hit mines in Hormuz.
WHY IT MATTERS
Brent oil rose 3.8% Thursday, then eased early Friday.
FOR YOU
Oil swings fast on Hormuz news, and fuel prices can follow within weeks.
slides.body: Iran says more tankers hit mines in Hormuz. Brent oil rose 3.8% Thursday, then eased early Friday. Oil swings fast on Hormuz news, and fuel prices can follow within weeks.

slides.title: Tech stocks tumble after vote
slides.image_prompt: Glowing computer chip on a circuit board, lit in red, with a downward arrow of light falling across it
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The Nasdaq fell more than 5% on Thursday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Investors are reassessing AI data centre plans after the vote.
FOR YOU
Hold tech funds? Expect swings. South Korea's KOSPI fell over 8% Friday.
slides.body: The Nasdaq fell more than 5% on Thursday. Investors are reassessing AI data centre plans after the vote. Hold tech funds? Expect swings. South Korea's KOSPI fell over 8% Friday.

slides.title: Hoax bomb threats hit flights
slides.image_prompt: Passenger jet parked on a wet runway at night under airport floodlights, empty tarmac, calm atmosphere
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
At least 20 European flights got hoax bomb threats Thursday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Second wave this week; no bombs found, no one blamed.
FOR YOU
Flying in Europe? Possible delays or diversions, so check your airline's updates.
slides.body: At least 20 European flights got hoax bomb threats Thursday. Second wave this week; no bombs found, no one blamed. Flying in Europe? Possible delays or diversions, so check your airline's updates.

slides.title: Judge pauses 250-ft arch plan
slides.image_prompt: Architectural model of a tall white stone arch on a wooden table beside a judge's gavel, soft studio light
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A judge blocked Trump's planned Washington arch for 14 days.
WHY IT MATTERS
It came hours after planners approved it 8–4.
FOR YOU
For at least 14 days, the 76-metre arch stays on paper.
slides.body: A judge blocked Trump's planned Washington arch for 14 days. It came hours after planners approved it 8–4. For at least 14 days, the 76-metre arch stays on paper.
